title: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning
abstract: arXiv:2608.18746v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: JEPA-style latent world models can use Euclidean distance to a goal latent as the cost for model-predictive control (MPC). Strong decoding of task variables, however, does not guarantee that this particular cost ranks candidate action sequences by real task progress. We call the latter property \emph{decision-metric alignment}. We introduce Plan-Real Spearman, which measures latent--real rank agreement on random plans, and CEM-stage Spearman, which measures the same agreement as cross-entropy-method (CEM) search concentrates its proposal. We analyze sufficient conditions under which latent distance preserves real-cost rankings, identifying encoder distortion, terminal rollout error, and candidate margins as the controlling quantities. Guided by the observed empirical alignment gap, DA-LeWM augments LeWM with inverse-dynamics and demonstration-conditioned goal-action heads. translated_title: 潜在世界模型中的决策度量对齐：MPC规划的诊断与动作条件目标
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18746v1 公告类型：新 摘要：JEPA风格的潜在世界模型可以使用到目标潜变量的欧氏距离作为模型预测控制（MPC）的成本。然而，对任务变量的强解码并不能保证这一特定成本能按真实任务进展对候选动作序列进行排序。我们将后一种属性称为“决策度量对齐”。我们引入了Plan-Real Spearman，用于衡量随机计划中潜在-真实排名的一致性，以及CEM-stage Spearman，用于衡量交叉熵方法（CEM）搜索集中其提议时的一致性。我们分析了潜在距离保持真实成本排名的充分条件，识别出编码器失真、终端展开误差和候选边际作为控制量。在观察到的经验对齐差距指导下，DA-LeWM通过逆动力学和演示条件目标-动作头增强了LeWM。在所有实验中，DA-LeWM加速了收敛并……
tldr: 本文提出决策度量对齐概念及其诊断指标，并引入DA-LeWM方法，通过逆动力学和演示条件目标增强潜在世界模型，以提升MPC规划中潜在距离与真实任务进展的排名一致性，从而加速收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of decision-metric alignment and its diagnostic metrics, and proposes DA-LeWM, which enhances latent world models with inverse dynamics and demonstration-conditioned goals to improve rank consistency between latent distances and real task progress in MPC planning, thereby accelerating convergence.
